integrity: The infinite theorem is proved analytically using rational generating functions, Chebyshev bounds and Pringsheim; a finite exact-rational Bernstein certificate verifies the low-index interval.
scientific_limitations: Exact-arithmetic, fixed-step, scalar exponential-kernel result for the optimized J=2 symbol only; neither general-kernel positivity nor PDE solution positivity follows. Priority against unidentified older specialized results remains a residual risk.
title: Sharp all-lag positivity threshold for exponential-kernel truncated-trapezoidal convolution quadrature
